raw_mentions: The CoPe Program welcomes proposals for Large-scale hubs via this solicitation. These awards are intended to support hubs that require larger budgets because of the scope of the science or geographical area involved ($2-$4 million per year). Due to the potential scope and complexity of the Large-scale hubs, the awards may be continuing grants or cooperative agreements.
Due to the potential scope and complexity of CoPe Hubs, the awards may be continuing grants or cooperative agreements.
